structural_change: PC SRAM CDC sram1h after 1e placed-reach FAIL 285 pairs (max 597.8 reset / 550.6 data: cells sprawled above the top macro row; AF write faces opposed their writer domains): domain-matched macro columns (phy W column MY: rx IB + rx AF; core E column R0: tx IB + tx AF) so every macro read face (LEF W) opens on the centre channel toward its reader and the writer sits on its own half; outline 475.2x540 (1e 648); std rows ONLY in the full-width central band y216..334.8 plus the full-height centre channel x226.8..253.8 beside the read faces (POST_FLOORPLAN row hook, no cell can sprawl to the corners); all data pins/pin flops in the band beside their clocks (W phy, E core), host_rst_n at the N-face centre above the band so the 2-stage landing sits mid-band.

reroute_reason.reason: Mapped native census found ir2187/wq_row1092loads and runtime flop arrays above2kb. Dedicated opt-in SRAM channel preserves effective4/8 FIFO capacities and exact PIPE2 transfers, with kept source state/reset/select copies.
